During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sadic]] maintained a '''laboratory''' in the Imperial [[Prison/Legends|prison]] district of [[Shadow Town]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. He worked on mass-producing [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guards]] there until his [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]], and the commandos of [[Blackstar Squad]] destroyed the facility with explosives.
